# SubNyquistWaveformReconstruction

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A technique to reconstruct full-bandwidth waveforms from samples taken below the Nyquist rate, leveraging the reservoir's temporal dynamics to recover missing information. Critical for reducing data rates and energy consumption in high-speed interconnect topologies, allowing sparse sampling without loss of signal fidelity.
